heading: Issues of fact in Supreme Court
lead: In all original actions at law in the Supreme Court against citizens of the United States, issues of fact shall be tried by a jury.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on title 28, U.S.C., 1940 ed., § 343 (Mar. 3, 1911, ch. 231, § 235, 36 Stat. 1156). Changes were made in phraseology.
